manualReview: Washer installation: the current 614 mm niche around a 600 mm body leaves 7 mm per side; verify the chosen product, hoses, ventilation and extraction route.
Laundry fronts and the bathroom door: simultaneous opening needs a chosen hinge system and a separate coordinated motion check.
Appliance hinge paths, hood coverage, plug/cable space and service access require product data.
Source geometry is traced, not measured. The model review does not certify construction dimensions or installation compliance.
limits: All wall cells and electrical attachments are checked; furniture separation is limited to declared pairs, not every object pair.
Non-box intersections use conservative oriented bounds and remain review candidates.
Ceiling joins use five footprint rays. Motion checks sample angles/distances and do not prove continuous swept clearance.
Navigation checks camera clearance using modeled obstacle envelopes and declared door poses, not human accessibility.
